name: delivered context
wording: a bounded context cratylus ships as part of the product: the current design of one of its own contexts, taken at release and placed read-only under the owned root with its origin, version and identity. It is the practice a project's agents work by, never part of the project's design: a project's views show it in a place of its own, apart from the project's own contexts, still offered first to a fresh session, never in the project's context map and never written into its journal. A project whose journal holds that same context, by the entry that first recorded it, reads its own instead, and there it is part of that project's design.
reason: The architect, applying the accepted ruling that a project's design is its own contexts: shown beside a project's contexts, the delivered practice was documented as part of the product's design, so it is now shown apart from them and never in their context map, while still read first.
